statement: Kernel wired IBEX feature messages use HID feature report ID 1 with 64-byte report capacity; command payload at offset1 is [command u8, payload_len u8, payload bytes]. It invokes SET_REPORT then GET_REPORT on feature ID 1 for exchange, validates returned command match and length >=2+declared payload length after removing ID, -EPROTO on short/malformed reply, retries protocol mismatch up to bounded attempts; -EPIPE raw requests retry at 20 ms intervals up to 50. hid-steam.c:433-585,593-665. This is host consumer behavior, not proof of actual hardware acknowledgement bytes.

applicability.revision: host consumers at Linux v7.3-rc1 and SDL 6defbc0; physical revision not measured
applicability.scope: Wired USB 28de:1302; host-side source parsing / host commands only, no live or physical validation. Refer to docs/steam-controller-2026-research-gaps.md C6 section.
